decision_reason: M1175 may only run the candidate exporter and document the export. It cannot run relocation replay, run mining, train actor weights, run PPO, promote, use private holdout, change actor inputs, or convert rows into a proof corpus.
failure_criteria: export collapses to old two-pair surface
replay, mining, actor training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, conversion, or actor-input change starts
forbidden_shortcuts: do not convert rows into a proof corpus
do not manually edit candidate CSVs
hypothesis: The M1174 exporter will produce a source-diverse action-divergent candidate CSV from M1161 outcome rows under the M1173 gates.

blocked_by: M1174 implements exporter tooling and focused tests
invalidates: relocation replay before candidate export audit
parent_objective: run the action-divergent candidate exporter on the M1161 outcome artifacts

public_gates: M1175 may run only the M1174 exporter command
M1175 must not run relocation replay
M1175 must not train actor weights
M1175 must not use private holdout
M1175 must not convert rows into a proof corpus
success_criteria: no replay, mining, actor training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, conversion, or actor-input change occurs
